relationships.subject: ACY-1215

key_findings: HDAC6 inhibition by ACY-1215 relieves SNI pain, shifting spinal STAT3 from phosphorylation toward acetylation and reducing nuclear p-STAT3.
HDAC6/STAT3 axis drives CCL7, TNF-α and IL-1β production in spinal neurons.
